derivation: a primitive root (compare H2673 (חָצָה)lemma חָעָה ayin, corrected to חָצָה); also as denominative from H2671 (חֵץ)
def: properly, to chop into, pierce or sever; hence, to curtail, to distribute (into ranks);  to shoot an arrow
kjv: archer, [idiom] bands, cut off in the midst.

occurrences.text: They that are delivered from the noise of archers in the places of drawing water, there shall they rehearse the righteous acts of the Lord, even the righteous acts toward the inhabitants of his villages in Israel: then shall the people of the Lord go down to the gates.
